title: AC1015 entities-3d empty-name shape STYLE output blocker

source.provenance: Existing local corpus candidate. Producer and redistribution status are unverified; the drawing remains outside the repository.

strictOutput.secondTarget: AC1024 output selection produced the same STYLE-table failure

libdxfrw.diagnosticChange: writeTables now reports the exact TABLES stage (VPORT, LTYPE, LAYER, STYLE, VIEW, UCS, APPID, DIMSTYLE, or BLOCK_RECORD) through the existing emit-failure diagnostic. It does not alter table output or failure behavior.

independentPeer.decoded: LibreDWG reports STYLE 0x38 with empty name, shape flag set, font es.shx; SHAPE 0x39 references style 0x38 with shapeId 131 and empty shape name.

dxfOutput.observation: The peer DXF has only the Standard STYLE row and emits SHAPE 0x39 with empty group-7 style and group-2 shape-name values. This is peer output behavior, not semantic acceptance proof.

formatReferences.finding: Documents group 2 as the style name, bit 1 of group 70 as a shape entry, and group 3 as the shape font filename. It does not specify whether an empty style name is valid.
Documents group 2 as the shape name; it does not resolve the meaning or consumer behavior of this empty-name pair.

assessment.finding: The generic TABLES failure is localized to STYLE. The source contains an empty-name shape STYLE that is referenced by a SHAPE entity. It cannot be safely dropped as unreferenced, and inventing a symbol name or accepting empty names would change or assume semantics.
assessment.nextAction: Keep strict conversion refused for this source until a producer-backed example or an independent native consumer establishes the validity and meaning of the empty STYLE/SHAPE pair. If accepted, bind its source fields and exact emitted rows/handles, then add focused round-trip and consumer controls.
assessment.fixturePolicy: No source DWG or peer-generated DXF fixture was added.
assessment.scopeLimit: Stage-level diagnostics shorten triage and identify this candidate's blocker. The peer's output alone does not establish a valid DXF profile, native shape rendering, complete AC1015 support, or promotion of any support claim.
